title: Improve the Index Mgmt page discoverability
summary: The index management page can now be opened directly from Tell Me or direct access, and it then shows a table selection dialog. Table Information gets a button to open it instead of the previous hyperlink, and empty datetimes show a dash instead of the minimum value.
key_points: Index management page can be opened directly and shows a table selection dialog
Page is found in Tell Me when searching for Index
Table Information gets a button to the index management page, replacing the hyperlink
DateTime minimum values display as a dash
quote: Change the design to support opening the page directly by showing a table selection dialog.
